title: From the Transformer to a Formal Semantics of Coordinated Transformations
abstract: arXiv:2610.39735v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a formal semantics for a general class of coordinated systems of parameterized transformations, taking the Transformer as a paradigmatic starting point but abstracting from its particular mathematical instantiation. Representational vectors receive both extensional reference and ordered intensional interpretations, while parameter structures acquire relative, second-level interpretations that determine how argument properties are preserved, replaced, or combined. This yields the notion of a transforming concept: a parameterized transformation whose numerical action is coordinated with a corresponding property-level map. We then distinguish the common algebraic-semantic core of these systems from their architecture-specific functional organization, allowing different mathematical instantiations and mechanical realizations of the same abstract system type. translated_title: 从Transformer到协调变换的形式语义学
translated_abstract: 我们为一类广义的参数化变换协调系统建立了一个形式语义学框架，以Transformer作为典型出发点，但从其特定的数学实例中加以抽象。表示向量同时获得外延指称和有序的内涵解释，而参数结构则获得相对的、二阶层次的解释，这些解释决定了论证性质如何被保留、替换或组合。由此产生了“变换概念”的概念：一种参数化变换，其数值作用与相应的性质层面映射相协调。随后，我们将这些系统的共同代数-语义核心与其架构特定的功能组织区分开来，从而允许同一抽象系统类型拥有不同的数学实例化和机械实现。该框架被应用于注意力头和残差连接……
tldr: 该论文以Transformer为出发点，为一类参数化协调变换系统建立了形式语义学，提出“变换概念”这一新概念，并将系统共同的代数-语义核心与架构特定的功能组织区分开来，应用于注意力头和残差连接。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a formal semantics for coordinated systems of parameterized transformations—using the Transformer as a paradigmatic starting point—introducing the notion of a "transforming concept" and separating the common algebraic-semantic core from architecture-specific functional organization, with applications to attention heads and residual connections.
